title: Handoff-brief delivery SLA — generation-to-delivery latency
summary: Time between the on_call_rotation playbook composing a structured handoff brief and the brief being delivered to the incoming responder along the pre-bound channel. Lower is better. Brief generation and brief delivery are deliberately separated as adjacent steps in the playbook so this KPI can report compose-time and deliver-time independently and a stuck delivery channel surfaces as a delivery-time regression rather than disappearing into total step latency.

target.rationale: Handoff briefs must reach the incoming responder before the shift opens to honour the rotation-handoff window.

measurement.formula: p95( notify_step_completion_time - generate_step_completion_time ) over rotation-handoff windows in window.

inputs.name: delivery_evidence
inputs.description: delivery confirmation observed in the bound channel's application-activity stream
